records.title: Production deploy window
records.body:
The production deploy window is Tuesday to Thursday, 09:00 to 15:00. Deploy
inside the deploy window so the person who deployed is still awake and watching
the deploy. A deploy outside the deploy window is a deploy nobody is watching.

records.title: Deploy window freeze rules
records.body:
The production deploy window is Tuesday to Thursday, 09:00 to 15:00. Deploy
outside the deploy window only to roll back, and announce the rollback deploy in
the release channel first. The deploy window is frozen at quarter end.
